name: Axtra's Utils
description: Disable visual effects, auto-click key simulation, and force 16:9 in Geometry Dash.

auto-click.name: Auto Click
auto-click.description: Simulate a key press at a certain percentage of the level (useful for muting Discord, etc.)

auto-click-percent.name: Trigger Percent
auto-click-percent.description: Percentage of the level at which the key will be simulated

orb-pulse-size.name: Orb Pulse Size
orb-pulse-size.description: The size of the orb pulse effect

force-16-9.name: Force 16:9
force-16-9.description: Adds black letterbox bars to display the game in 16:9
